I'm Divyansh. For most of last year I told everyone I was fine.

I wasn't. After Nanaji died and the startup folded in the same month, I stopped sleeping properly. I snapped at people. Some mornings I sat in the car outside the office for half an hour before I could go in. I kept thinking a stronger person would handle this alone.

I used to think asking for help was weak. Now I think it was the smartest thing I did all year.
